class Solution {
    PrintWriter out;
    FastScanner fs;
    int MOD;

    public Solution(PrintWriter out, FastScanner fs) {
        this.out = out;
        this.fs = fs;
    }

    public void solve(int total, int index) {
        int n = fs.nextInt();
        MOD = fs.nextInt();

        long[][] dp = new long[n][n * n + 5];
        dp[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < dp[0].length; j++) {
                for (int cnt = 0; cnt <= i; cnt++) {
                    if (j - cnt >= 0) {
                        dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j - cnt];
                        dp[i][j] %= MOD;
                        if (dp[i][j] == 0) {
                            dp[i][j] += MOD;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        long[][] sums = new long[dp.length][dp[0].length];
        for (int i = 0; i < dp.length; i++) {
            long sum = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < dp[0].length; j++) {
                sum += dp[i][j];
                sum %= MOD;
                if (sum == 0) sum += MOD;
                sums[i][j] = sum;
            }
        }

        long[] fact = new long[501 * 501];
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < fact.length; i++) {
            fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % MOD;
        }

        long[][] ncr = new long[501][501];
        ncr[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < ncr.length; i++) {
            ncr[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < ncr[0].length; j++) {
                ncr[i][j] = (ncr[i - 1][j] + ncr[i - 1][j - 1]) ) % MOD;
                if (ncr[i][j] == 0) ncr[i][j] += MOD;
            }
        }

        long result = 0;
        for (int i = n - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            int cnt = n - i;
            int pre = n - cnt;
            long comb = (ncr[n][pre] * fact[pre]) % MOD;
            long sumVal = 0;
            for (int dif = 1; dif < cnt; dif++) {
                for (int inv = dif; inv < dp[0].length; inv++) {
                    if (dp[cnt - 2][inv] == 0) break;
                    if (inv - dif - 1 < 0) continue;
                    long x = dp[cnt - 2][inv];
                    long y = sums[cnt - 2][inv - dif - 1];
                    x = (x * y) % MOD;
                    if (x == 0) x += MOD;
                    sumVal += x * (cnt - dif);
                    sumVal %= MOD;
                }
            }
            result += sumVal * comb;
            result %= MOD;
        }
        out.println(result % MOD);
    }
}
